sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A multi-platform fight across three add phases (Hydra, Destroyer, Wyverns) before a final burn on Qadim himself. 13-minute enrage. One of the more mechanically dense fights in the raid roster — worth watching a video alongside these notes the first few times.

sections.heading: General rules
bullets: Tanking is proximity-based — stand at the enemy's hitbox center to hold aggro. Tank Chronomancers are common picks for the portal utility.

Each Legendary Enemy follows Autoattack → Autoattack → Special Ability. When a platform transition starts, the enemy gets a red circle — everyone must leave it within 2 seconds or get teleported straight to Qadim.

sections.heading: Hydra phase
bullets: Applies debuffs via cone attacks, uses Flamebreath after 2 autoattacks, then gets a breakbar — break it before it leaps or the leap punishes hard.

sections.heading: Destroyer phase
bullets: Apocalypse Bringer spawns with an opening breakbar and 3 adds — same shockwave-special-ability pattern as the others.

sections.heading: Wyverns phase
bullets: Needs 2 tanks: one holds the Matriarch away from the group, one holds the Patriarch with the squad. Both use tailswipe and flamebreath.
An NPC ally (Zommorros) helps tank the Patriarch and contributes a large share of the damage on both wyverns.

sections.heading: Final phase (33% → 0%)
bullets: Platforms spin erratically as terrain evaporates. Two Pyres spawn — reach Qadim by jumping across or using portals.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 13:00 — Qadim stacks Fiery Empowerment (+20% damage, +2% attack speed per stack), making a slow kill snowball fast.
